summary: Make remediation intent projections atomic and analyzable

delivery.outcome: Make target-owned remediation DSL projections atomic, byte-verifiable and correlated with only their own todo2code evidence before an LLM plans refactoring
nonGoals: Do not change todo2code itself or add it as a runtime dependency
Do not store populated target reports, plans or remediation intents in this Governance Hub
Do not let todo2code or an LLM expand accepted scope or grant approval
Do not clean or rewrite unrelated user worktrees, branches or historical plans

architecture.decision: Keep the accepted remediation intent authoritative, project exactly one todo2code-readable record per action, verify declared projections byte-for-byte and correlate advisory diagnostics and plans through the todo2code graph before checking them
interfaceChanges: render-todo2code can write atomically to taskPath and todoPath declared by the accepted intent
verify-todo2code fails when a declared projection is missing, stale or escapes the selected repository root
analyze-todo2code accepts a todo2code intent graph and scopes plans and diagnostics to projection record IDs
dataChanges: Canonical task and TODO projections encode one complete actionable sentence per remediation action
The advisory overlay binds the analyzed todo2code graph digest and projection record IDs
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded branch before publication; after publication issue a patch release while preserving the previous immutable contract

commands: Run todo2code deterministically against canonical REMEDIATION.task.md and REMEDIATION.todo.md, then analyze its graph, diagnostics and plan set
for suite in tests/*.test.sh; do bash $suite; done
